values.note: Free, first come; no reservations at Kansas state fishing lakes (only the KDWP cabin books). Seven consecutive days, then five days away (K.A.R. 115-8-9(c), amended 2023); a longer stay needs a written KDWP permit.

values.note: Undesignated primitive spots on the south and east shores; KDWP posts no rig limit. The access is 2.5 miles of hilly gravel road from K-7 that can be slick when wet.

sites.source: KDWP Atchison SFL page (Wayback 2026-07-11), read 2026-11-06 (the stored 25 ft came from a camper's 'fine for ~25-ft rigs', which describes a fit, not a limit, and I couldn't find the report again)

note: KDWP state fishing lake (66 acres) in the Independence Creek valley, 2.5 miles of hilly gravel off K-7 that can be slick when wet. Free primitive camping on the south and east sides, first come, no hookups; restrooms and picnic areas, rural water at the SE entrance. Seven-day limit. --Claude
summary: KDWP page (Wayback; live 403) + KDWP camping rules: free, FCFS, 7-day max (added), water at SE entrance confirmed; max_rig_ft 25 -> cleared (a fit remark, not a limit; source not refound). Lakefront kept, soft. Phone (none) -> 913-367-7811 (manager). Pin in woods; optional move.
flags: PHONE (none) -> 913-367-7811 (KDWP manager Kirk Thompson, on the Atchison SFL page). WEBSITE fine.

WATERFRONT 'lakefront' kept, but soft. KDWP allows camping 'on the south and east side' with no marked sites. On the south shore an open mown lawn runs 15-40 m from the gravel drive to the water, and two gravel spurs run out onto jetties. The east side has gravel spurs to the shore off the loop road, under trees. Nothing blocks the water from the lawn. But I can't tell whether that lawn is designated camping or the picnic area KDWP mentions, so this is the same weak spot as Barber (2088).

PIN 39.6326,-95.1765 is in solid woods about 30 m south of the shore road, not on a camping spot. Optional move to 39.6327,-95.1780, the open south-shore lawn between the two jetty drives by the restroom, about 130 m W. RV Life's 39.633,-95.17854 is on the west jetty.
ACCESS: '2.5 miles of gravel road from K-7 ... like a roller coaster and can be slick when wet'. It's a hilly gravel approach but KDWP doesn't mention 4WD, so no drop.
STALE ALERT: the page still carries a 2020-21 drawdown alert ('until work is completed in late spring of 2021'); imagery shows the lake full.
The KDWP cabin is reservable separately ('No tents or campers at cabin without approval'); it's not part of the camping.
